picks.title: Sea of fog tomorrow 6:56am
picks.body: 71% chance the valley fills with fog at sunrise. Get above it: Silver Star Mountain, Larch Mountain: Sherrard Point.
why: 71% chance of fog or low cloud in the valley at sunrise (HRRR)
no fresh sounding: assumes viewpoints above 450 m clear the fog
picks.lens: 70-300 to stack the ridges above the fog; 16-50 for the wide view

picks.title: Colourful sunrise likely tomorrow 7:02am
picks.body: 31% odds of colour. Best bets: Neskowin Ghost Forest, Maryhill Loops Road (switchbacks), Maryhill Museum of Art grounds. Horizon toward the sun is 17% open.
why: 92% chance of a colourful sunrise sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the rising sun 17% open (25–300 km)
picks.lens: 16-50 wide, foreground first; bracket for the bright horizon

picks.title: Cackling Goose at Ridgefield National Wildlife Refuge
picks.body: Cackling Goose sightings here are near their yearly high this week. Go early: dawn and the two hours after are best.
why: GBIF weekly share of records (presence-only, not encounter odds)
picks.lens: 70-300 (use the 1.5x crop as reach; keep your distance)

picks.title: Fall colour near peak at Sandy River Delta (Thousand Acres)
picks.body: Satellite images show the trees here near peak colour (as of Nov 4). Soft overcast or the first sun brings it out best.
why: Sentinel-2 colour index vs. summer baseline
picks.lens: 27 or 16-50; overcast light is your friend for saturated leaves

note: Odds within 48 h are HRRR; beyond that Open-Meteo, capped at 55% because a single model can't give real odds.
